# CHAPTER 3 — THE RED DOOR · درِ قرمز
**15:00 – 22:30 · 450 s · frames 21601–32400 · story clock 01:30–02:05**
Chapter objective: follow the voice past the forbidden door. Discovery: the room of Subject 001.

**SCENE ID:**
CH03_SC001

**CHAPTER:**
3 — THE RED DOOR

**START TIME:**
15:00

**END TIME:**
15:55

**DURATION:**
55 s = dialogue 22 s (4 lines, 37 words, all whispered ≈1.8 w/s, 3 pauses) + action beats 30 s (Sara climbs down 4 · CU tape on strike plate 5 · door pushed, soft crunch, they listen 5 · Sam turns over and mumbles, they freeze 6 · Arin tightens his palm bandage, looks up at the vent 5 · they slip out, Sara re-presses the tape 5) + held reaction 3 s (motivated: frozen while Sam moves)

**LOCATION:**
INT. SURVIVOR ROOM (B1) — NIGHT — story clock 01:30. Lock engaged from outside since 01:00.

**CHARACTERS:**
Arin, Sara, Sam (asleep)

**STORY PURPOSE:**
Sara's preparation pays off: the "locked" room was never locked. Sara reveals the crying has a name tonight. The two become a team.

**VISUAL DESCRIPTION:**
Dark dormitory lit only by the blue night light leaking under the door. Six bunks, cans, the camping lamp off. Sam a heavy shape under a blanket, a peach can on his chest rising and falling. The vent grille above the bunks is a black rectangle. On the inside of the door frame, the old scratch marks; on the strike plate, Sara's strip of grey duct tape from 2.4.

**CAMERA SHOTS:**
1. CU, 85 mm, 3P static — Sara's fingers press the duct tape on the strike plate; the outside bolt sits on tape, not steel. (6 s)
2. MS two-shot, 35 mm, 3P, slight push-in — Arin and Sara whisper at the door. (14 s)
3. WS top-down, 24 mm, 3P — Sam rolls over, mumbles; both freeze mid-step. (8 s)
4. MCU, 50 mm, 3P — Arin tightens the gauze on his left palm, eyes on the vent. (6 s)
5. MS, 35 mm, 3P, over Arin's shoulder — Sara: "three nights". (12 s)
6. POV, 18 mm, slow handheld — the door eases open onto the blue corridor. (5 s)
7. Reverse MS, 35 mm, from the corridor — door pulled to; Sara presses the tape flat again. (4 s)
Total 55 s.
Transition between 1→2 straight cut; 5→6 cut on Arin's step.

**CHARACTER ACTION:**
Sara drops from the top bunk on bare socks, boots in her hand, and pulls them on at the door. She pushes the door with two fingers; the tape tears with a soft crunch and the bolt slides off it. Sam turns, mumbles; both stop with their weight on one foot. Arin pulls his jacket on, winds the gauze tighter with his teeth. Sara holds the door so the hinge doesn't squeak and, once outside, smooths a new strip of tape on the plate so the room looks locked.

**FACIAL EXPRESSIONS:**
Sara: a small, proud half-smile that drops to seriousness when she speaks about the crying. Arin: tense, jaw set, eyes darting to the vent. Both: breath held, eyes wide, during Sam's movement.

**DIALOGUE:**
**سارا:** [whispers] [smug] قفلشون برای کسی که از قبل آماده باشه، قفل نیست.
**آرین:** [whispers] از کی داری این کارو می‌کنی؟
**سارا:** [whispers] [serious] سه شبه. [short pause] هر شب ساعت دو، یکی از پایین گریه می‌کنه. [short pause] امشب برای اولین بار یه اسم گفت.
**سام:** [mumbles] [sleepy] هلوها مال منه...

**SOUND EFFECTS:**
Sam's slow snore; tape tearing; bolt scraping off tape; the hinge creak avoided (one tiny squeak cut short); boots laced; distant electrical hum through the vent; Arin's breath through the nose.

**MUSIC:**
None. Room tone only. A single low sustained cello note enters on "یه اسم گفت" and holds into the next scene.

**LIGHTING:**
Practical: blue LED night strip under the door (6500 K, very low). Bounce from the corridor lights the door edge. Faces in silhouette, rim from the gap. No fill.

**BLENDER REQUIREMENTS:**
ENV_SURVIVOR_ROOM (bunks, door with animated hinge + bolt). CHAR_ARIN (jacket, left palm gauze), CHAR_SARA (olive field jacket, grey hoodie, black jeans, boots), CHAR_SAM (sleeping pose, blanket cloth sim or baked). PROP_DUCT_TAPE_STRIP, PROP_PEACH_CAN, PROP_BUNK_BED x6. ANIM_SARA_CLIMB_DOWN_BUNK, ANIM_SARA_PULL_BOOTS, ANIM_SARA_PUSH_DOOR_SOFT, ANIM_SAM_SLEEP_TURN, ANIM_ARIN_TIGHTEN_BANDAGE, ANIM_ARIN_SARA_FREEZE_MIDSTEP. Lip sync: Sara x2 lines, Arin x1, Sam mumble. Frames 21601–22920.

**TRANSITION:**
Cut from the door clicking shut (reverse) to the corridor grille in POV.

**CONTINUITY NOTES:**
Arin's left palm gauze (pharmacy, 1.4). Blood-test cotton on Arin's right inner elbow (2.5). Sara still has the cut duct tape roll in her jacket pocket. Sam stays asleep in the room until CH04_SC003. Door appears locked from outside.

**CLIFFHANGER OR STORY CHANGE:**
They are out of the room. Sara: tonight the crying said a name — Arin's.

**START TIME:**

**END TIME:**

**DURATION:**
50 s = dialogue 10 s (3 lines, 13 words whispered + 2 pauses) + action beats 40 s (POV walk to first grille, ear to slats 6 · nothing, move on 5 · Sara traces the duct along the ceiling with a finger 4 · second grille: the hum louder; Arin hums two notes of it without noticing, Sara turns 8 · Mark's spot: two cigarette butts, one still smoking 5 · ceiling camera with red LED sweeping; they wait under it and pass behind its turn 8 · duct ends at the red door 4)

**LOCATION:**
INT. CORRIDOR B1 — NIGHT — 01:32. Night mode: blue strips, every second ceiling panel off.

**CHARACTERS:**
Arin, Sara

**STORY PURPOSE:**
The voice leads them to the forbidden door. Arin knows the lullaby without knowing why (clue to his past). Mark was here minutes ago.

**VISUAL DESCRIPTION:**
A long concrete corridor painted pale grey, a cable tray and a square steel duct along the ceiling, grilles every six metres. Wet floor reflections of blue strips. At the far end, the dull red door with one red LED. A small dome camera on the ceiling sweeps 90° every few seconds.

**CAMERA SHOTS:**
1. POV, 18 mm, steady handheld walk — to the first grille. (6 s)
2. ECU, 100 mm, 3P — Arin's ear at the slats, his breath fogging the metal. (5 s)
3. MS, 35 mm, 3P — Sara points along the duct. (4 s)
4. MCU, 50 mm, 3P, slow push — Arin hums; Sara stops and turns; their lines. (12 s)
5. Insert, 85 mm — two butts on the floor, a thread of smoke. (5 s)
6. Low angle, 24 mm, 3P — the dome camera's sweep; the two flatten against the wall and cross under it as it turns away. (11 s)
7. WS, 28 mm, slow push-in — the end of the corridor: the red door. (7 s)
Total 50 s.

**CHARACTER ACTION:**
Arin moves grille to grille, presses an ear, holds his breath. Sara walks backwards beside him watching the far end. At the second grille Arin unconsciously hums two notes of the lullaby. Sara grabs his sleeve. Arin crouches at the butts, touches one — warm — and looks around. They time the camera: Sara counts with her fingers 3-2-1, both slide along the wall.

**FACIAL EXPRESSIONS:**
Arin: concentration, then a blank, slightly frightened look when Sara points out the humming — he didn't know he was doing it. Sara: suspicious surprise, then focused. Both: tight mouths at the camera.

**DIALOGUE:**
**سارا:** [whispers] [surprised] تو این آهنگو از کجا بلدی؟
**آرین:** [whispers] [unsure] نمی‌دونم. [short pause] همیشه تو سرم بوده.
**سارا:** [whispers] دوربین. [short pause] بعد از چرخش.

**SOUND EFFECTS:**
Air hiss in the duct; the faint lullaby (girl's voice, filtered through metal, very low); a drip; the dome camera's servo whine; their soft steps on wet concrete; cigarette ember crackle.

**MUSIC:**
The cello note from SC001 continues and fades when the humming starts. The lullaby (diegetic) is the only melody.

**LIGHTING:**
Blue LED strips at floor level (night mode), every second ceiling panel off, leaving pools of dark. Red LED at the door as the far accent. Camera dome red pilot light.

**BLENDER REQUIREMENTS:**
ENV_CORRIDOR_B1 (module variant B1-night: dressing = mop alcove at end, fire hose, two grilles with louvres), ENV_RED_CORRIDOR end piece. PROP_VENT_GRILLE, PROP_DOME_CAMERA (rotating, animated), PROP_CIGARETTE_BUTT x2 + FX_SMOKE_WISP. ANIM_ARIN_LISTEN_GRILLE, ANIM_SARA_WALK_BACKWARD_WATCH, ANIM_ARIN_CROUCH_TOUCH_FLOOR, ANIM_PAIR_WALL_SLIDE. Hum: Arin lip shape "m" closed-mouth hum. Frames 22921–24120.

**TRANSITION:**
Push into the red LED → match cut to the LED on the card reader (SC003).

**CONTINUITY NOTES:**
Cigarette butts = Mark smoked here (as in 2.6) and left within the last minutes. Dome camera: still recording on mains power (feeds control room; matters for CH04: Mark could have seen them on it). Door to survivor room looks locked.

**CLIFFHANGER OR STORY CHANGE:**
The voice and the duct both end at the red door. Arin knows a song he never learned.

**LOCATION:**
INT. CORRIDOR B1 / RED DOOR — NIGHT — 01:34.

**CHARACTERS:**
Arin, Sara, Mark; Elena (voice on radio)

**STORY PURPOSE:**
They cross the line Elena forbade. Elena's spare card works. A radio call plants that the outside camera "saw something" (the convoy, CH04).

**VISUAL DESCRIPTION:**
The red door close: dull painted steel, scuffed at kick height, card reader with one LED. To the right, a narrow utility alcove: mops, a yellow bucket, a shelf of bleach. A flashlight beam cuts the far end of the corridor, swinging. Behind the door, metal stairs going down into red emergency light.

**CAMERA SHOTS:**
1. CU, 85 mm — the white blank keycard slides from Sara's sleeve. (4 s)
2. MS two-shot, 35 mm — whispers at the door. (10 s)
3. WS, 24 mm, 3P from behind them — the flashlight beam swings into the corridor. (5 s)
4. MS, 35 mm — inside the alcove, the mop tips, Arin catches it. (5 s)
5. CU, 50 mm, low — the beam crosses the bucket; Sara's boot toe in the edge of the light. (6 s)
6. MS, 50 mm, Mark in silhouette at the alcove mouth — "کسی اونجاست؟", the radio, his reply. (12 s)
7. ECU, 100 mm — Arin's eye in darkness, unblinking. (4 s)
8. WS, 28 mm — Mark walks off; keys clinking; beam shrinking. (6 s)
9. ECU, 85 mm — reader: red + denied beep; flip; green. (7 s)
10. POV, 18 mm — door opens on red stairs; breath fogs. (7 s)
11. MS, 35 mm, 3P from the stairwell — the door closes behind them on its closer; Sara's line. (4 s)
Total 70 s.

**CHARACTER ACTION:**
Sara shows the card between two fingers like a playing card. Arin hears the clank first and hooks her arm. In the alcove they press back between mops; Arin's bandaged hand nudges a mop handle and he grips it before it hits the floor. Mark stops, flashlight low, head turned to listen; his free hand rests on the rifle grip. Radio squawk on his chest — he answers and walks away. Sara swipes too fast — denied — breathes, flips the card, swipes slowly.

**FACIAL EXPRESSIONS:**
Sara: dry defiance at "drawer", then fear she hides by biting her lip. Arin: wide-eyed, then the eye in ECU fixed and steady. Mark (half-lit): tired, suspicious, not hostile. Relief flicker at the green LED.

**DIALOGUE:**
**آرین:** [whispers] [surprised] اینو از کجا آوردی؟
**سارا:** [whispers] از کشوی میزِ دکتر. [short pause] اونم چیزای زیادی از ما برداشته.
**مارک:** [low] [suspicious] کسی اونجاست؟
**النا (بی‌سیم):** [calm] [muffled] مارک، بیا ورودی. دوربینِ بیرون یه چیزی دیده.
**مارک:** [low] [tired] دارم میام.
**سارا:** [whispers] [nervous] اگه بفهمه کارتش نیست...
**آرین:** [whispers] نمی‌فهمه. [short pause] برو.

**SOUND EFFECTS:**
Distant steel door clank; flashlight switch; Mark's boots, heavy and slow; rifle sling creak; radio squelch and Elena's compressed voice; keys clinking away; reader denied beep (two low tones), accepted chirp; magnetic lock release thunk; door seal sigh; cold air rushing; door closer hiss and click.

**MUSIC:**
Low pulsing synth bass (60 bpm heartbeat) starts with the flashlight, stops dead on Mark's "کسی اونجاست؟", resumes softly after he leaves, and drops out at the green LED.

**LIGHTING:**
Blue night strips + the hard white flashlight beam (moving, motivated) as the key on faces for seconds only. Red LED reader. Stairwell: red emergency lamps, deep shadows.

**BLENDER REQUIREMENTS:**
ENV_RED_CORRIDOR (red door, animated: lock + swing + closer), ENV_UTILITY_ALCOVE (mops, bucket, shelf). CHAR_MARK (dark security uniform, no badges, rifle, flashlight, chest radio), CHAR_ARIN, CHAR_SARA. PROP_KEYCARD_WHITE_BLANK, PROP_CARD_READER (LED states red/green), PROP_MOP x3, PROP_BUCKET_YELLOW, PROP_FLASHLIGHT (spot light), PROP_RADIO_CHEST, PROP_RIFLE_MARK. ANIM_SARA_CARD_FROM_SLEEVE, ANIM_ARIN_PULL_SARA_HIDE, ANIM_ARIN_CATCH_MOP, ANIM_MARK_PATROL_STOP_LISTEN, ANIM_MARK_RADIO_ANSWER, ANIM_SARA_SWIPE_CARD x2. FX: breath fog (stairwell). Frames 24121–25800.

**TRANSITION:**
Door closes → black for 6 frames → POV on the stairs (SC004).

**CONTINUITY NOTES:**
Red door now closed again behind them, unlocked from inside by push bar. Elena's white spare card in Sara's jacket chest pocket. Mark goes to reception/entrance (the convoy on the outside camera). Elena is awake and in reception at 01:35.

**CLIFFHANGER OR STORY CHANGE:**
They are behind the red door. Something outside has been seen by the camera.

**LOCATION:**
INT. STAIRWELL → B2 COLD STORAGE → B2/B3 GRILLE — NIGHT — 01:37.

**CHARACTERS:**
Arin, Sara; one infected in a body bag (unseen)

**STORY PURPOSE:**
The Centre stores bodies — and they are not all dead. Sara is wounded on her right palm: now both of them carry a cut palm (key for 7.5 and 8.6).

**VISUAL DESCRIPTION:**
Metal stairs in red light; stencil B2. A long cold room: steel shelves to the ceiling, frost on pipes, black body bags with white number tags only. Breath clouds. At the far end, the next stair down blocked by a rusted grille bent half open, its lower edge jagged.

**CAMERA SHOTS:**
1. POV, 18 mm — down the stairs to the B2 stencil. (6 s)
2. WS, 24 mm, 3P — the cold room reveal, breath fog in red light. (6 s)
3. Tracking MS, 35 mm, lateral dolly — they walk past the shelves. (6 s)
4. Slow push CU, 50 mm — a bag on the low shelf bulges as if a head turns inside. (6 s)
5. MCU, 50 mm — Sara frozen, her line. (5 s)
6. MS, 35 mm, 3P following — Arin takes her wrist, his line; they walk on. (11 s)
7. ECU, 100 mm — the zip pull trembles, stops. (4 s)
8. MS, 28 mm — the rusted grille. (4 s)
9. CU, 85 mm — Sara's right palm on the jagged edge; the cut; she bites back the sound; her line. (8 s)
10. MS, 35 mm — Arin squeezes through. (4 s)
11. CU two hands, 50 mm — the strip of hoodie, the knot; the last two lines. (15 s)
Total 75 s.

**CHARACTER ACTION:**
Sara pulls her hoodie collar over her nose against the smell. When the bag moves she stops dead, both hands to her mouth. Arin, without turning his head, closes his good hand round her wrist and walks her on at the same slow pace, eyes forward. Sara goes through the grille first, sideways; her right hand slips on the edge. On the other side she sits on a step, hand clamped; Arin kneels, she rips the hem of her grey hoodie with her teeth, he ties it.

**FACIAL EXPRESSIONS:**
Sara: disgust → terror (eyes very wide, nostrils flared) → pain (teeth clenched, eyes squeezed) → a tired, crooked smile at the end. Arin: controlled fear, not looking at the bag, jaw trembling; gentle while tying.

**DIALOGUE:**
**سارا:** [whispers] [trembling] اون... تکون خورد.
**آرین:** [whispers] [calm] نگاش نکن. [short pause] فقط راه برو.
**سارا:** [pained] [whispers] چیزی نیست. [short pause] برو.
**آرین:** [whispers] دستتو بده.
**سارا:** [whispers] [weak laugh] حالا جفتمون یه دستِ زخمی داریم.

**SOUND EFFECTS:**
Refrigeration compressor drone; ice ticking on pipes; their breath; a slow wet rustle of plastic inside the bag; zip teeth clicking once; rusted grille scrape; a sharp metal snag and Sara's stifled hiss; fabric tearing.

**MUSIC:**
Silence except the compressor until the bag moves: a sub-bass swell, very low, then nothing. A two-note piano motif (the "wound" motif, used again in 7.5 and 8.6) plays softly on the last line.

**LIGHTING:**
Red emergency lamps every 8 m; cold room: one flickering white tube at the far end (practical) that silhouettes the shelves. Frost catches red highlights. Volumetric haze from the cold.

**BLENDER REQUIREMENTS:**
ENV_STAIRWELL_RED, ENV_B2_COLD_STORAGE (modular shelf units, frosted pipes), PROP_BODY_BAG x24 (one with shape-key "head turn" + zip pull bone), PROP_RUSTED_GRILLE (bent, jagged). FX: breath fog particles, volumetric haze, frost material. CHAR_SARA damage variant: right palm cut → bandage strip (SARA_HAND_R_BANDAGE). ANIM_SARA_COVER_MOUTH_FREEZE, ANIM_ARIN_LEAD_BY_WRIST_SLOW, ANIM_SARA_SQUEEZE_THROUGH_GRILLE, ANIM_ARIN_SQUEEZE_THROUGH_GRILLE, ANIM_PAIR_TIE_BANDAGE (finger contact). Frames 25801–27600.

**TRANSITION:**
Cut on the knot pulled tight → straight cut to the B3 stencil.

**CONTINUITY NOTES:**
Sara: right palm cut, bandaged with a grey strip of her hoodie hem (hoodie now has a torn hem). Arin: left palm gauze. The moving bag (B2 shelf, low, near the far end) is the crawler that comes up the service shaft in 5.1. The grille stays bent open.

**CLIFFHANGER OR STORY CHANGE:**
The dead here move. Both of them now have a bleeding palm.

**LOCATION:**
INT. B3 CELL CORRIDOR — NIGHT — 01:42.

**CHARACTERS:**
Arin, Sara; infected in cells 006 (Z4), 007 (Z6); Nika (voice only)

**STORY PURPOSE:**
The facility holds infected people as "subjects". Visual clue for the audience only: the infected man lowers his head to Arin. Nika is close.

**VISUAL DESCRIPTION:**
A long corridor of cells, thick laminated observation windows with wire inside, steel doors with stencilled codes SUBJECT 004 … SUBJECT 011. Red emergency light, a slow drip from a pipe into a puddle. Most cells dark. Hospital gowns, plastic beds bolted to the floor.

**CAMERA SHOTS:**
1. WS, 24 mm, 3P — the corridor; they enter small at the far end. (5 s)
2. POV, 24 mm — window 004: empty bed, cut straps. (5 s)
3. MS through glass, 50 mm — 006: woman facing the wall, rocking; stops. (8 s)
4. MS two-shot, 35 mm, tracking — Sara's line. (5 s)
5. CU, 85 mm, through glass, Arin soft in background — 007: the man's eyes follow; he steps back and drops his head as Arin passes; Arin, looking at Sara, doesn't see. (9 s)
6. POV, 35 mm — 008: handprints of dried blood inside. (5 s)
7. ECU, 100 mm — Arin listening: the hum below, then the voice; his whisper. (9 s)
8. Tracking MS, 28 mm, backward dolly — Arin hurrying to the end, Sara behind. (9 s)
Total 55 s.

**CHARACTER ACTION:**
They walk the middle of the corridor, away from the windows. Sara keeps her bandaged hand against her chest. At 007 the man moves only his eyes; when Arin is level with him he steps back from the glass and lowers his head like a scolded dog. Arin stops at the sound from below, turns his head toward the floor, then walks fast.

**FACIAL EXPRESSIONS:**
Sara: horror, pity at "they're people". Arin: dread, then hope and urgency at the voice. 006 woman: slack face. 007 man: grey skin, focused eyes, then a lowered, submissive look (subtle).

**DIALOGUE:**
**سارا:** [whispers] [horrified] اینا آدمن... [short pause] لباسِ بیمارستان تنشونه.
**نیکا (دور):** [echoing] [whispers] آرین... نیا...
**آرین:** [whispers] [desperate] نیکا؟

**SOUND EFFECTS:**
Drip into puddle; buzzing of a failing emergency lamp; the 006 woman's bed creaking with her rocking, stopping; 007's breath fogging the glass; fingernail squeak on glass; the hum below (filtered); Nika's voice with long metallic reverb.

**MUSIC:**
High sustained string harmonics, barely audible; they cut out when Nika speaks.

**LIGHTING:**
Red emergency light from ceiling cages, strong falloff; cell interiors mostly dark with faint red spill through the windows; 006 has a dim blue night lamp inside (to read her silhouette).

ANIM_Z4_ROCK_FACE_WALL, ANIM_Z6_TRACK_EYES_STEP_BACK_BOW, ANIM_ARIN_STOP_LISTEN_FLOOR, ANIM_ARIN_FAST_WALK. Frames 27601–28920.

**TRANSITION:**
Backward dolly ends on the two small doors at the end of the corridor (SC006 starts there).

**CONTINUITY NOTES:**
Cells 004–011 locked (magnetic, powered). 007 man's behaviour = clue C1 for the audience only; Arin and Sara do not notice. Nika's voice comes from below (deeper B3 — chamber 002), not from the lab in SC008.

Nika's voice, close now, tells him not to come.

**STORY PURPOSE:**
Reveal R1: Arin was here as a child, as Subject 001. A drawing hints that someone held a door open for him (prepares R3).

**VISUAL DESCRIPTION:**
A room smaller than the cells: a child-size bed with restraint straps, a little desk and chair, a faded rug. On the wall, crayon drawings yellowed with age: two children under a big sun, one tall, one small, holding hands; the small one has a red line drawn on her wrist; names in a child's Persian hand — آرین, نیکا. On the doorframe, marker height marks with dates scratched out, ages ۶ – ۷ – ۸, each with "001". On the desk, more drawings; one shows a tall man in dark clothes holding a door open, a small boy running out.

**CAMERA SHOTS:**
